job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior LibreChat Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and strong expertise in deploying, customizing, and integrating LibreChat-based AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with LLM-powered applications, API integrations, containerized deployments, and modern web technologies.

The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade conversational AI platforms using LibreChat while ensuring scalability, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Deploy, configure, and customize LibreChat environments for enterprise use cases.
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models.
Develop custom plugins, tools, workflows, and extensions within LibreChat.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and backend services.
Integrate authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth, SSO, JWT, LDAP, SAML).
Configure and optimize vector databases and retrieval systems for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications.
Manage Docker-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines.
Implement monitoring, logging, and performance optimization strategies.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to deliver conversational AI solutions.
Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and governance standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

5+ years of software development experience.
Strong experience with LibreChat deployment and customization.
Proficiency in:
JavaScript (ES6+)
TypeScript
Node.js
React.js
Next.js
Experience with:
MongoDB
PostgreSQL
Redis
Strong understanding of:
REST APIs
GraphQL
WebSockets
Hands-on experience with:
Docker
Docker Compose
Kubernetes
Linux environments
Experience integrating LLM APIs and AI platforms.
Knowledge of vector databases such as:
Pinecone
Weaviate
Chroma
Milvus
Familiarity with prompt engineering and RAG architectures.
Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices.

AI & LLM Experience

Experience working with:
GPT models
Claude models
Gemini models
Open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, etc.)
Understanding of:
Prompt optimization
Context management
Embeddings
Function calling / tool usage
Agent-based workflows

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise chatbot implementations.
Knowledge of cloud platforms:
AWS
Microsoft Azure
Google Cloud
Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Experience implementing SSO and enterprise security controls.
Contributions to open-source AI or LibreChat projects.
Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices.
